Everyone talks about machine learning models — but very few people talk about the engineers who make those models actually work in production. Those engineers are ML Data Engineers, and in 2026 they’re among the highest‑paid roles in AI and data.

In India, entry‑level ML Data Engineers typically earn around ₹6 to ₹10 LPA, depending on city, company, and skill set. With 3 to 6 years of experience, salaries often move into the ₹12 to ₹20 LPA range, and in strong product or AI‑first companies they can go even higher. Senior professionals who are strong in data engineering, ML infrastructure, and MLOps commonly reach ₹25 to ₹40 LPA or more, especially in top tech hubs.

In the United States, ML Data Engineer salaries usually start around $110,000 to $130,000 per year, with experienced and senior roles easily crossing $200,000 in total compensation at leading product and AI companies. This is where “data + ML + cloud” really starts to pay off.

A Generative AI Architect designs and implements systems that generate new, realistic content — from text and images to music and videos — using AI models like GPT-5.2, GANs, and VAEs.

author: Simplilearn
description:
Platform Engineers are becoming one of the highest-paying tech roles in 2026. These professionals build and manage the platforms that power modern applications and cloud systems.

Platform Engineers handle cloud infrastructure, microservices deployment, system scaling, and developer platforms that help companies run their technology smoothly.

Let’s look at the Platform Engineer salary in 2026. In India, entry-level engineers can earn around ₹14–16 LPA, while experienced engineers can make ₹18–25 LPA. In top companies, senior platform engineers can earn ₹70 LPA or more.

In the United States, salaries are even higher. Platform engineers earn $120K–$160K for mid-level roles and $200K–$350K+ for senior roles.

If you want to increase your salary, learning cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, DevOps, and microservices architecture can help you grow faster in this career.
